adapters.refused.backend_unsupported: Refused a model ({family}): its runtime runs on none of these backends, listed best first: {detail}. Pass --device auto to use what this machine offers, or name another device with --device or the device setting.
adapters.refused.cpu: Refused on the CPU ({family}): it needs MPS, MLX or CUDA and would take many hours here. If this machine has one, pass --device auto or name it with --device. Transcription, voice, tagging and mixing still run on the CPU.
adapters.refused.device_unavailable: Refused device {detail}: this machine does not offer it. Pass --device auto to use what it offers, or name another device with --device or the device setting.
cli.device.help: Run the models on this backend: auto, mps, mlx, cuda or cpu. Given, it wins over the device setting, auto included; left out, the device setting decides.
cli.run.help: Take a Story through every stage into a new Run folder.
cli.run.story.help: The name of the Story's folder under stories/ in the working directory.
cli.working_dir.help: Use this folder as the working directory instead of the default place.
content_types.auto.label: Auto (the model picks)
content_types.book_chapter.label: Book chapter
content_types.drug_story.label: Drug story
content_types.scary_story.label: Scary story
events.sink_failed: Event sink {sink} failed and gets no further events: {reason}
run.refused.no_story: Refused run: there is no Story named {detail} in {path}.
run.refused.run_id_taken: Refused run: every run id drawn, the last {detail}, already has a Run folder in {path}.
settings.device.help: Where the models run: auto picks Apple Silicon (MLX, then MPS), then CUDA, then the CPU; a backend named here goes first, then its Apple Silicon partner if the machine has it, then the CPU. A given --device flag, auto included, wins over this setting.
settings.device.label: Device
settings.quality_preset.help: The Quality preset a Run fills its render settings from: fast, balanced or best.
settings.quality_preset.label: Quality preset
settings.refused.preset_name_taken: Refused setup preset {detail}: {path} already holds a setup preset of that name.
settings.refused.preset_unknown: Refused setup preset {detail}: {path} holds no setup preset of that name.
settings.runs_to_keep.help: How many Runs of a Story to keep, the new Run included; each new Run moves the oldest beyond this count to the trash.
settings.runs_to_keep.label: Runs to keep
settings.story_language.help: The language a Story is told in: the narrator's voice speaks it and the transcription listens for it. It may differ from the UI language.
settings.story_language.label: Story language
settings.ui_language.help: The language of the app's own text: menus, cards, messages and the terminal lines of a command.
settings.ui_language.label: UI language
workdir.refused.cannot_create: Refused working directory {path}: it cannot be created ({detail}). Choose another place with {option} or {env}.
workdir.refused.in_temp: Refused working directory {path}: it is inside the temporary folder {detail}, which the system may empty on reboot. Choose another place with {option} or {env}.
